approved.en: Russian forces continue drone and missile strikes on Ukrainian civilian sites, including a recent attack on an Oryol electronics plant and repeated hits on Moscow-area airports, while Ukrainian forces retaliate with strikes on the same airports, a factory in Tolyatti and an airfield in Krasnodar Krai. In occupied Oleshky, a local cease-fire negotiated by Melania Trump has reduced fighting, and a separate truce was agreed for another town. Ukraine reports that Starlink speed restrictions have been lifted, restoring stable connectivity for its military. A secretive Ukrainian deep-strike unit is expanding its campaign, and Ukraine’s Sine Engineering has launched a joint defence technology initiative with Finland. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Israeli forces have launched a multi-day military operation in the occupied West Bank, expanding a lockdown, razing a neighbourhood in Hebron and carrying out home demolitions after two Israeli soldiers were shot dead and two gunmen were killed. Simultaneously an Israeli airstrike hit a building in Nuseirat, Gaza, captured on video, and raids in Hebron detained dozens of Palestinians. The United Nations cut food aid, leaving displaced West Bank Palestinians facing growing hunger. The conflict produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Hezbollah explosives seized from two Lebanese trucks have led Lebanon's prime minister and security forces to promise a thorough investigation while Israeli artillery and air strikes continue against Hezbollah positions in southern Lebanon, causing civilian casualties. In northern Israel a Hezbollah submunition exploded in a teenager's backpack, killing Elazar Yair Wilensky and wounding dozens, prompting an IDF probe and possible hike restrictions. Qatar has pledged funding for reconstruction in southern Lebanon, announced a massive solar plant project, and its foreign minister called for Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon. The UCDP recorded 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Nord-Israel eksploderte en Hezbollah-submunisjon i en tenårings ryggsekk, og drepte Elazar Yair Wilensky og såret dusinvis, noe som har ført til en IDF-undersøkelse og mulige restriksjoner på høyde. Qatar har lovet finansiering til gjenoppbygging i Sør-Libanon, kunngjort et massivt solkraftprosjekt, og utenriksministeren oppfordret til israelsk tilbaketrekning fra Libanon. approved.en: Iran has threatened to strike Gulf oil facilities, AI sites and undersea cables and reports seven ships hit in the Hormuz Strait, while Saudi Arabia’s King Fahd airport was hit by missiles, killing one person and wounding eight, prompting the United States to order its personnel to leave Saudi Arabia and advise diplomats to depart. Russian Foreign Minister Lavrov visited Tehran and publicly backed Iran, hinting at possible Russian involvement as the United States and Israel draft plans for renewed strikes after the US midterm elections. Saudi Arabia is expanding a missile plant that may produce more powerful missiles. 123 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

Russlands utenriksminister Lavrov besøkte Teheran og støttet offentlig Iran, og antydet mulig russisk involvering mens USA og Israel lager planer for nye angrep etter USAs midtveisvalg. Saudi-Arabia utvider et missilverk som kan produsere kraftigere missiler. 123 kamprelaterte dødsfall skjedde i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Houthi forces have stepped up missile and drone attacks on Saudi Arabia, striking Riyadh, Khamis Mushait, Dammam airport and an air base, while Saudi defenses have intercepted multiple missiles and drones over Saudi territory. In Yemen, a Houthi airstrike on a house in Sanaa killed three people and a Saudi strike in Yemen killed four civilians, including women and children, and Houthi attacks in Taiz killed two children and wounded three civilians. The United Nations warns that time is running out to reach the besieged city of Taiz as water supplies dwindle in another Yemeni city under Houthi siege. Oil prices rose to a five-month high after Houthi attacks disrupted crude markets. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Israeli forces fired across the border into southern Syria, killing a disabled Syrian man in the Daraa buffer zone and deploying rooftop snipers who opened fire in the south. Two Syrian security officers were killed in a raid on an ISIL cell near Damascus, while security operations in Rankous and a separate incident in the Damascus countryside saw further clashes. Protesters gathered across Syria to denounce repeated Israeli incursions, and a road linking Damascus and Suwayda was blocked amid demands for detainees' release, while the Sweida-Damascus highway was completely closed by outlaw groups. Arms depot explosions in Syria left 37 dead, according to reports. 2732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Iraqi authorities condemned the deadly attack on a Greek Orthodox church in Jordan and arrested suspects, while Iraqi leaders blamed external agents for the incident. The Iraqi prime minister pledged to place armed factions and weapons under state control by June 2027 and warned that these groups could be drawn into a US-Iran conflict. Iranian forces were accused of severe border violations and smuggling, and the Iraqi border with Saudi Arabia was declared fully secured. Saudi Arabia postponed a UN forum to 2027 amid regional tensions, and Türkiye is preparing to hand over the Bashiqa-Zilkan base to Iraq. 396 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

Iraks statsminister lovet å plassere væpnede fraksjoner og våpen under statlig kontroll innen juni 2027 og advarte om at disse gruppene kan bli trukket inn i en US-Iran-konflikt. Iranske styrker ble anklaget for alvorlige grensebrudd og smugling, og den irakiske grensen mot Saudi-Arabia ble erklært fullt sikret. Saudi-Arabia utsatte et FN-forum til 2027 på grunn av regionale spenninger, og Tyrkia forbereder å overlevere Bashiqa-Zilkan-basen til Irak. 396 kamprelaterte dødsfall ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Sudanese armed forces have continued drone strikes on markets in the disputed Abyei border region, killing dozens of civilians in each attack. Communal clashes persist between SSPDF and SPLA-IO forces in Kapoeta North, Eastern Equatoria, and in Wij-Panyikang, Upper Nile, while an ambush killed two people in Kajo-Keji County. Monitors warned of rising violence ahead of December elections and reported 40,000 people displaced by renewed Upper Nile fighting. The UCDP recorded two battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Observatører advarte om økende vold før valgene i desember og rapporterte at 40 000 personer er fordrevet av den fornyede kampanjen i Upper Nile. UCDP registrerte to dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Fitgharan forces now control the Mogadishu-Baidoa corridor while Laftagareen forces have seized Buurhakaba and another town in the Bay region, expanding fighting in southern Somalia. Al Shabaab detonated an IED in Mandera, injuring six civilians, and the ICRC treated 148 wounded after heavy combat in Baidoa. Ethiopia has withdrawn more than 3,000 troops and will not intervene in the South West State conflict, while a UAE drone strike in Puntland killed four family members, including a pregnant teenager. The US and UAE carried out airstrikes against al-Shabaab in northern Somalia, and 2,284 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

Survivors of the Eseka rail disaster are still waiting for justice ten years after the crash. A French court has greenlit a third-party funder’s enforcement of an ICC award against Cameroon. President Paul Biya, aged 93, remains in office despite frequent absences. The conflict caused 231 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Overlevende fra Eseka-togkatastrofen venter fortsatt på rettferdighet ti år etter ulykken. En fransk domstol har godkjent at en tredjepartsfinansiør kan håndheve en ICC-dom mot Kamerun. President Paul Biya, 93 år gammel, sitter fortsatt i embetet til tross for hyppige fravær. Konflikten forårsaket 231 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Mozambique's army is now reported to be losing a crucial counter-insurgency battle in Cabo Delgado, indicating a setback for security forces against the insurgents. The government continues its December deadline for civilians to surrender illegal firearms and has recently killed another member of the Anamola group in the province. Forces linked to Erik Prince suffered a battlefield loss in Congo, with a former UFC fighter among the wounded, showing the conflict's regional spillover. The insurgency caused 151 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Regjeringen opprettholder sin frist i desember for at sivile skal levere inn ulovlige skytevåpen, og har nylig drept et nytt medlem av Anamola-gruppen i provinsen. Styrker knyttet til Erik Prince led et tap på slagmarken i Kongo, med en tidligere UFC-utøver blant de sårede, noe som viser konfliktens regionale spredning. Opprøret forårsaket 151 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Libyan armed forces have executed 31 people after unfair military trials, breaking a 15‑year moratorium, while rights groups report eastern authorities carrying out executions and 50 detainees face imminent execution. Heavy rainfall in Tripoli caused at least three deaths in one incident and two deaths in separate incidents, adding to flood-related casualties. The European Union has expanded migration cooperation with eastern Libya, and China has called for an end to Libya’s political deadlock. A football match between Morocco and Libya will be broadcast on beIN SPORTS as part of the 2026 Futsal AFCON. There were two battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Kraftig nedbør i Tripoli forårsaket minst tre dødsfall i én hendelse og to dødsfall i separate hendelser, noe som øker antallet dødsfall knyttet til flom. Minst to personer ble drept i en eksplosjon i hovedstaden i Rakhine. Konflikten forårsaker fortsatt sivile tap, med 2 332 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Manipur protests continue with thousands banging utensils, drums and horns against rising violence, while security forces fire tear gas at crowds in Kangla Fort and other towns. In Kashmir, a woman was killed after being hit by a scooter in Baramulla and a man died in a road accident on Rajouri Road, while a six-year-old boy was killed by a tractor in Tangmarg. The Kuki-Zo Women’s Forum has called for President's Rule in Manipur, describing the crisis as political rather than security related. Gaurav Gogoi has again questioned the Centre's response and demanded accountability. 437 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Kashmir ble en kvinne drept etter å ha blitt truffet av en scooter i Baramulla, og en mann døde i en veitrafikkulykke på Rajouri Road, mens en six-year-old boy ble drept av en traktor i Tangmarg. Kuki-Zo Women’s Forum har krevd President's Rule i Manipur og beskriver krisen som politisk snarere enn sikkerhetsrelatert. Gaurav Gogoi har igjen stilt spørsmål ved sentralstyrets respons og krevd ansvarlighet. 437 battle-related deaths ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

The Philippine Coast Guard rescued 20 people off Basilan and opened an upgraded station on Pag-asa Island, but its personnel were killed and another wounded in a shooting in Cotabato City. Taiwan has offered cooperation with the Philippines on protecting undersea cables and an ex-NSA has urged activation of the Philippines-China coast guard agreement. 176 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

Filippinernes kystvakt reddet 20 personer utenfor Basilan og åpnet en oppgradert stasjon på Pag-asa-øya, men deres personell ble drept og en annen såret i en skyting i Cotabato City. Taiwan har tilbudt samarbeid med Filippinene om beskyttelse av undersjøiske kabler og en tidligere NSA har oppfordret til aktivering av avtalen mellom Filippinene og Kina om kystvakten. 176 dødsfall knyttet til kamper fant sted i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Mexican authorities have charged a state prosecutor with treason for alleged U.S. involvement in a drug raid and arrested an alleged cartel leader linked to a deadly car bombing, while U.S. pressure mounts for a security win ahead of midterm elections. A Texas man was indicted for buying firearms in Amarillo to supply the Sinaloa Cartel, and a Sinaloa Cartel transporter pleaded guilty to trafficking methamphetamine and marijuana. A Hells Angels boss was arrested in Cancún, marking a second biker bust in 2026, and a fifth suspect was indicted for purchasing guns for the cartel. The conflict’s historical toll includes 37 battle-related deaths in 1996, according to UCDP.

En texansk mann ble tiltalt for å kjøpe våpen i Amarillo for å forsyne Sinaloa-kartellet, og en transportør for Sinaloa-kartellet erklærte seg skyldig i narkotikasmugling av metamfetamin og marihuana. En Hells Angels-leder ble arrestert i Cancún, noe som markerer en andre biker-aksjon i 2026, og en femte mistenkt ble tiltalt for å kjøpe våpen til kartellet. Konfliktens historiske kostnad inkluderer 37 dødsfall i kamper i 1996, ifølge UCDP.

A car bomb at Casanare toll booths injured four women and a video shows the attack, and a drone strike at a Colombian police station injured six officers. A drone attack in Guapi, Cauca, killed one Marine and wounded four soldiers. Ecuador arrested four FARC dissident leaders on the border, linking cross-border rebel activity to the Colombian conflict. The country hosts a Regional Laboratory for Drone Warfare. There were 225 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

En bilbombe ved bomstasjoner i Casanare såret fire kvinner, og en video viser angrepet, og et droneram mot en colombiansk politistasjon såret seks betjenter. Et droneram i Guapi, Cauca, drepte en marine og såret fire soldater. Ecuador arresterte fire FARC-dissidentledere ved grensen, og knyttet grenseoverskridende opprørsaktivitet til den colombianske konflikten. Landet er vert for et regionalt laboratorium for dronkrigføring. Det var 225 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

Opposition groups are staging nationwide protests demanding elections and the return of Machado, and a Dutch security report warns that Venezuela’s instability could threaten Curaçao and the wider Caribbean Kingdom. The Pentagon has issued a directive banning DoD personnel from using nonpublic information to bet on U.S. military operations, including those involving Venezuela. The U.S. Embassy has reopened in Venezuela to full staff, and there were 2 battle-related deaths in 2007, according to UCDP.

Opposisjonsgrupper holder landsomfattende protester som krever valg og at Machado kommer tilbake, og en nederlandsk sikkerhetsrapport advarer om at Venezuelas ustabilitet kan true Curaçao og det bredere Karibiske kongeriket.
